resolution_policy: Use Tanzil Qur'an text plus Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology; no OpenITI Qur'an substitution and no near-match morphology fork.

records.notes: Standalone text exports were downloaded with no pause, sajdah, rub-el-hizb, tatweel, or sequential-tanween options. simple-clean is matching text; uthmani is display text.

records.notes: The official download requires a contact-email form; the two public copies were byte-identical (same SHA-256) and retain the original copyright block. The QAC header identifies its embedded Tanzil text as Uthmani v1.0.2; standalone text used here is Tanzil v1.1.

conversion.input: QAC ROOT: values in Buckwalter transliteration
conversion.method: camel_tools.utils.charmap.CharMapper.builtin_mapper("bw2ar"); roots are deduplicated in first-appearance order per verse.

output.shape: JSON list of {sura, aya, text, text_uthmani, roots}
